evidence.text: Northwind Logistics operates a freight-matching platform used by mid-sized European carriers.
Northwind raised a Series B round in 2025 to expand its routing analytics.
Northwind Logistics has 3 roles in your job data: Data Analyst, Senior Data Engineer, Platform Engineer.
Globex — Data Engineer: Built Spark batch pipelines processing 2 TB of shipment events per day
Globex — Data Engineer: Migrated 40 cron jobs to Airflow DAGs with alerting
